Account background and commercial notes:
- ARR: $360k committed first year; 3-year term in SOW (auto-renew).
- Exec sponsor: Maria Santos (Head of Data Platforms).
- Procurement: small list of bespoke redlines — Logan handled legal; procurement@clearwavehealth.com is in copy.

Technical highlights & constraints:
- Data residency required: US-East only (no EU).
- Customer-managed key (HSM-backed) required for prod buckets.
- Okta SCIM + SAML SSO required.
- Expected peak qps modest; production throughput estimate: 30–40 reqs/s with bursts.

2) Legal redlines: one lingering clause about data retention; confirm retention window (SOW states 7 years) — need to get confirmation from customer.
3) Embedding pipeline ownership: who will own transformation code on their side vs. Redwood's integration (we typically provide guidance + sample sync job).
4) SSO attributes: we must validate the expected group attributes for role mapping.

Proposed internal owner assignments (please confirm or reassign):
- Implementation owner: tessa_morgan (CS) — overall accountability and runbook creation.
- Solutions/technical lead: karthik_iyer — architecture & SSO/KMS design, pre-kickoff tech scoping.
- Account exec: logan_wright — escalation & procurement sync.

Immediate asks for the team before 10 Nov kickoff:
- Karthik: draft a 30-minute architecture pre-read that covers KMS integration steps, SCIM attributes, and quantization/throughput plan (due 6 Nov).
- Tessa: assemble the runbook template + mutual action plan and owner roster (due 6 Nov).
- Logan: obtain KMS contact and confirm the final retention term with procurement/legal (due 3 Nov).

I'll capture this in HubSpot and drop the kickoff invite once we have owner confirmation.

Thanks — big opportunity, want to deliver a frictionless kickoff.

— Logan
